description: Use this when the user asks a SAFE calculator question such as how much of the company a SAFE buys: ownership = investment / post-money valuation cap for a YC post-money SAFE (or the pre-money SAFE equivalent), plus combined ownership with other SAFEs, the SAFE price and share count. Ownership is as converted at the caps, before any priced round. Does not model a priced round, notes or option pool top-ups; use calculate_cap_table for those. Not legal or tax advice.

company_shares.description: Fully diluted shares before the SAFEs convert (founders, options, pool), e.g. 10000000. Used for share counts and the SAFE price; default 10,000,000.

discount.description: Discount in percent, e.g. 20 for 20% (a YC "discount rate" of 80% is read as a 20% discount).

mfn.description: true for an MFN SAFE: it takes the lowest cap and highest discount of SAFEs listed after it.

name.description: Investor or SAFE label, e.g. "Angel SAFE".

type.description: post (YC post-money SAFE, default) or pre (pre-money SAFE).

valuation_cap.description: Valuation cap, e.g. 8000000 or "$8M". Post-money cap unless type is pre.

other_safes.description: Other SAFEs converting alongside it, e.g. [{"amount":250000,"valuation_cap":6000000}] or "$250k at $6M cap". Combined SAFE ownership is shown.

safe_type.description: post (YC post-money SAFE, default) or pre (pre-money SAFE).

valuation_cap.description: Valuation cap, e.g. 10000000 or "$10M" (post-money cap unless safe_type is pre).

name: calculate_safe_ownership
title: Calculate SAFE ownership
